name: Zum Wohl Tirol
kurzbeschreibung:
**Cheers to Tirol in Serfaus!**

---

**Welcome to the heart of the Alps** – where breathtaking nature, world-class skiing, and authentic Tyrolean charm await you in **Serfaus-Fiss-Ladis**. Whether you're carving fresh powder on the slopes, soaking in thermal baths, or savoring a hearty **Kaiserschmarrn** with a view, this alpine paradise promises unforgettable moments.

**Serfaus** is a year-round destination, offering:
✔ **200+ km of ski runs** – perfect for all levels, from beginners to freeriders.
✔ **Sunny slopes** – guaranteed snow until late spring.
✔ **Adventure & relaxation** – from hiking and mountain biking to cozy **Hütten** (mountain huts) with **Speckknödel** and **Gröstl**.
✔ **Cultural gems** – explore **Innsbruck**, **Swoveld**’s historic trails, or the charming villages of **Ladis** and **Fiss**.

**Stay in style** – from luxury hotels with spa facilities to rustic **Gasthöfe** serving homemade **Apfelstrudel** and **Kaiserschmarrn**.

**Plan your escape** – whether it’s winter wonderland or summer serenity, **Tirol**’s magic is waiting in **Serfaus**.

---
**Prost & genieße!** 🍻⛷️
